title: The decision on the Ayten Korkmaz case
paragraphs: In the case of South Daily correspondent Ayten Korkmaz on charge of spreading false information publicly, the verdict was announced. The result is that the verdict should be dropped (HAGB).

According to the indictment, Ayten Korkmaz has released information that will mislead the public with the news of torpedoed appointments at the public institution published on 8 December 2025. The sentence is carried out: Turkish Penal Code 217/A (the public publicly spreading misleading information).
The verdict was issued by Mersin 6th Criminal Court on August 13, 2026, which has not yet been issued.
In Ayten Korkmaz's case, Attorney Nesrin Guler demanded that the trial be concluded in a reasonable time, saying the case had not been concluded for two years.
Ayten Korkmaz is working as a journalist for Mersin at the South Newspaper, and journalism organisations said the case could have a deterrent effect on freedom of the press.
There will be a recrimination of the decision.
